svg.title: SLAP2 glutamate signal quality, candidate B: k-means classes
svg.desc: A shows one raw trace with detected events and an amplitude measurement; B its footprint; C and D the DMD1 and DMD2 dendritic maps of the example session, with scale bars. Sources are colored by archive-wide k-means class. E overlays one example source from each class; F shows the archive in the below-2 versus at-least-4-SD event-fraction plane; G the class composition of pools and sessions.
